autofocus.zh-CN: 挂载后自动聚焦输入框。

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除按钮图标的 snippet，showClear 为 true 时有效。
clearIcon.en-US: Snippet of the custom clear button icon; valid when showClear is true.

composition.zh-CN: 是否启用输入法组合模式，开启后组合输入期间不触发 onChange，组合结束后触发一次。
composition.en-US: Whether to enable composition mode. When enabled, onChange is not called during IME composition and is called once after it ends.

currency.zh-CN: 货币种类，可选值有 CNY、EUR、USD 等。设为 true 时使用 defaultCurrency，未设置时为语言包对应的货币；裸写 currency 等同于 true。
currency.en-US: Currency, such as CNY, EUR or USD. When true, uses defaultCurrency, or the currency of the locale pack when that is not set; a bare currency attribute equals true.

currencyDisplay.zh-CN: 货币展示方式，可选 symbol、code、name。
currencyDisplay.en-US: How the currency is shown: symbol, code or name.

defaultCurrency.zh-CN: currency 为 true 时使用的货币种类，优先级为自身属性、全局默认值、语言包。
defaultCurrency.en-US: Currency used when currency is true. Priority: own prop, global default, locale pack.

formatter.zh-CN: 指定输入框展示值的格式，一般与 parser 同时设置。优先级为自身属性、全局默认值。
formatter.en-US: Format of the displayed value, usually set together with parser. Priority: own prop, global default.

hideButtons.zh-CN: 隐藏步进按钮；与 innerButtons 同时为 true 时也不显示内置按钮。
hideButtons.en-US: Hides the step buttons; with innerButtons also true, no built-in button is shown either.

hideSuffix.zh-CN: 清除按钮显示时隐藏后缀，默认两者并列。
hideSuffix.en-US: Hides the suffix while the clear button is shown; by default the two sit side by side.

innerButtons.zh-CN: 将步进按钮放在输入框内部，悬停或聚焦时显示，并临时替换 suffix。
innerButtons.en-US: Puts the step buttons inside the input, shown on hover or focus and temporarily replacing the suffix.

inputStyle.zh-CN: 原生 input 的样式，只接受字符串。
inputStyle.en-US: Style of the native input. Accepts a string only.

insetLabelId.en-US: The id of the inset label.

keepFocus.zh-CN: 点击步进按钮时保持输入框聚焦。
keepFocus.en-US: Keeps the input focused when a step button is clicked.

localeCode.zh-CN: 货币模式下用于格式化的语言地区代码，如 zh-CN、en-US、de-DE。优先级为自身属性、全局默认值、LocaleProvider 或 ConfigProvider 的语言包。
localeCode.en-US: Locale code used for formatting in currency mode, such as zh-CN, en-US or de-DE. Priority: own prop, global default, locale pack of LocaleProvider or ConfigProvider.

maximumFractionDigits.zh-CN: 显示的最大小数位数，传给 Intl.NumberFormat。
maximumFractionDigits.en-US: Maximum number of fraction digits shown, passed to Intl.NumberFormat.

maxlength.zh-CN: 输入框文本的最大长度。
maxlength.en-US: Maximum length of the input text.

minimumFractionDigits.zh-CN: 显示的最小小数位数，传给 Intl.NumberFormat。
minimumFractionDigits.en-US: Minimum number of fraction digits shown, passed to Intl.NumberFormat.

minlength.zh-CN: 输入框文本的最小长度。
minlength.en-US: Minimum length of the input text.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开输入框与清除按钮时的回调，事件为 Input 外层元素的 focusout。
onBlur.en-US: Called when focus leaves the input and the clear button. The event is the focusout of the Input wrapper.

onChange.zh-CN: 值变化时的回调。第二个参数是触发变化的事件：输入、步进按钮 pointerdown、方向键或 Home/End 键、失焦。挂载和父级传入新值不触发，越界值按原样显示，用户操作时才校正并通知。
onChange.en-US: Called when the value changes. The second argument is the event that caused it: typing, a step button pointerdown, an arrow or Home/End keydown, or blur. Mounting and a new value from the parent do not call it; an out-of-range value is shown as given and is corrected and reported only after a user action.

onClear.zh-CN: 点击清除按钮时的回调。
onClear.en-US: Called when the clear button is clicked.

onCompositionEnd.zh-CN: 输入法组合结束时的回调。
onCompositionEnd.en-US: Called when an IME composition ends.

onCompositionStart.zh-CN: 输入法组合开始时的回调。
onCompositionStart.en-US: Called when an IME composition starts.

onCompositionUpdate.zh-CN: 输入法组合过程中的回调。
onCompositionUpdate.en-US: Called while an IME composition updates.

onDownClick.zh-CN: 按下减小按钮步进时的回调，长按连续步进时每步触发一次；参数为步进后的值与 pointerdown 事件。
onDownClick.en-US: Called when pressing the decrease button steps the value, once per step while it is held; the arguments are the stepped value and the pointerdown event.

onEnterPress.zh-CN: 在输入框中按下 Enter 时的回调。
onEnterPress.en-US: Called when Enter is pressed in the input.

onFocus.zh-CN: 焦点进入输入框时的回调；焦点在输入框与清除按钮之间移动不触发。事件为 Input 外层元素的 focusin。
onFocus.en-US: Called when focus enters the input; moving focus between the input and the clear button does not call it. The event is the focusin of the Input wrapper.

onInput.zh-CN: 原生 input 事件的回调。
onInput.en-US: Callback for the native input event.

onKeyDown.zh-CN: 在输入框中按下按键时的回调。
onKeyDown.en-US: Called when a key is pressed in the input.

onKeyUp.zh-CN: 在输入框中松开按键时的回调。
onKeyUp.en-US: Called when a key is released in the input.

onNumberChange.zh-CN: 数字变化时的回调，事件参数同 onChange。
onNumberChange.en-US: Called when the number changes; the event argument is as in onChange.

onUpClick.zh-CN: 按下增大按钮步进时的回调，长按连续步进时每步触发一次；参数为步进后的值与 pointerdown 事件。
onUpClick.en-US: Called when pressing the increase button steps the value, once per step while it is held; the arguments are the stepped value and the pointerdown event.

parser.zh-CN: 指定从 formatter 转换回数字串的方式，与 formatter 搭配使用。优先级为自身属性、全局默认值。
parser.en-US: Converts the text from formatter back to a number string; used together with formatter. Priority: own prop, global default.

precision.zh-CN: 数值精度，即保留的小数位数。
precision.en-US: Numerical precision, the number of fraction digits kept.

pressInterval.zh-CN: 长按步进按钮时，连续触发的间隔，单位毫秒。
pressInterval.en-US: Interval in milliseconds between repeats while a step button is held.

pressTimeout.zh-CN: 长按步进按钮时，开始连续触发前的延迟，单位毫秒。
pressTimeout.en-US: Delay in milliseconds before repeating starts while a step button is held.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 聚焦时是否阻止浏览器滚动文档以显示输入框，作用于组件内的 focus 调用。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether focusing stops the browser from scrolling the document to the input; applies to focus calls inside the component.

readOnly.zh-CN: 原生 `readonly`：只禁止键入，保留清除按钮；`readonly` 同时隐藏清除按钮。
readOnly.en-US: Native `readonly`: blocks typing only and keeps the clear button; `readonly` also hides the clear button.

scientificNotation.zh-CN: 启用科学计数法显示：失焦时显示科学计数法，聚焦时显示完整数字。可传入 `{ threshold }` 配置阈值，默认 15 位有效数字。不支持货币模式。
scientificNotation.en-US: Shows scientific notation when blurred and the full number when focused. Pass `{ threshold }` to configure the threshold, 15 significant digits by default. Not supported in currency mode.

shiftStep.zh-CN: 按住 Shift 时每次改变的步长，可以为小数。
shiftStep.en-US: Step of each change while Shift is held; may be a decimal.

showClear.en-US: Whether to show the clear button.

showCurrencySymbol.zh-CN: 是否显示货币符号、代码或名称，仅货币模式下生效。
showCurrencySymbol.en-US: Whether to show the currency symbol, code or name; only in currency mode.

size.en-US: Input size: default, small or large.

step.zh-CN: 每次改变的步长，可以为小数。
step.en-US: Step of each change; may be a decimal.

suffix.zh-CN: 后缀内容的 snippet；innerButtons 的按钮显示期间被替换。
suffix.en-US: Snippet of the suffix content; replaced while the innerButtons buttons are shown.

validateStatus.en-US: Validation status: default, error, warning or success.

value.zh-CN: 当前值，可用 `bind:value` 双向绑定。输入的中间态或非法文本为字符串，清空时为 ''。`bind:value={get, set}` 时完全受控；只传 `value` 时作为初值。
value.en-US: Current value; bind it with `bind:value`. A partial or invalid text is a string and a cleared input is ''. `bind:value={get, set}` makes it fully controlled; a plain `value` is the initial value.

focus.zh-CN: 聚焦输入框；未传 options.preventScroll 时使用 preventScroll 属性的值。
focus.en-US: Focuses the input; preventScroll prop applies when options.preventScroll is not given.

getInput.zh-CN: 返回原生 input 元素，卸载后为 null。
getInput.en-US: Returns the native input element; null after unmount.

getNativeElement.zh-CN: 返回组件根元素，卸载后为 null。
getNativeElement.en-US: Returns the root element of the component; null after unmount.

select.zh-CN: 选中输入框中的全部文本。
select.en-US: Selects all the text in the input.

setSelectionRange.zh-CN: 设置选区，参数同原生 setSelectionRange。
setSelectionRange.en-US: Sets the selection, with the parameters of the native setSelectionRange.
